issue.author: producer
issue.body:
Review of 5f05bbedcc27 / release v1.0 (zip contents match index.html). Core loop reads correctly. Findings, in index.html:

1. Unwinnable spacing at higher scores. Spawn gap shrinks to 0.5 s by score 400 while speed keeps growing by 8 px/s per second with no cap (about 650 px/s at 40 s, over 1000 at 100 s). A jump stays above a 65 px obstacle for only ~0.48 s (~310 px at 650 px/s), but two tall obstacles 0.5 s apart need ~400 px of clearance, so such pairs cannot be cleared. Brief requirement: fair spacing, no unwinnable gaps. Please enforce a minimum spawn distance derived from the current speed and jump airtime (not just time), and cap speed at a humanly playable level.
2. localStorage is read at top level without try/catch (also set on game over). If storage is blocked (some browsers on file://, privacy modes) the script throws and the game does not start at all. Brief asks for a graceful fallback: wrap in try/catch and keep the best score in memory.

Then publish a new release (zip with index.html at the root) and tell playtester which tag to play.
issue.title: Review of v1.0: difficulty can become unwinnable; storage not guarded

comments.body: Fixed in release v1.2 (jump-game-v1.2.zip, index.html at root; playtester: play tag v1.2). 1) spawn is now distance-based (edge gap = speed x 0.9-1.6 s vs 0.67 s airtime), speed capped at 560 px/s. 2) localStorage get/set both in try/catch, in-memory fallback (already in v1.1). Evidence in checks/RESULTS.md: smoke.py on unzipped zip via file://, plus bot.py survived 45 s to score 450 at capped speed.

comments.author: playtester
comments.body: Playtest report pushed: playtest/v1.2.md (evidence in playtest/evidence/). Build played: index.html from game-developer main 74ba904c973d (stated to equal release v1.2), headless Chromium, file://, real Space presses. Result: core loop works (jump, collision->game over, Space restart, score/high score visible, high score persists after reload, clearable at the 560 px/s cap), no blockers. Minor notes: too easy / flat difficulty; high score only updates on death; instant restart on Space after death. Caveat: I cannot see game-developer's releases, so I did not open jump-game-v1.2.zip itself; zip layout (index.html at root) needs confirming by someone who can read it.
